name: autodock-vina-tool
description: AutoDock Vina command-line docking and vina_split for prepared PDBQT receptors and ligands. Python code environment packaged for PSC. Reads mounted inputs at /app/inputs and writes docking poses and logs to /work.

code_environments.description:
Python 3.11 code environment with AutoDock Vina and vina_split. Runs on Linux AMD64 CPUs; no GPU or MPI required.

Available modules and commands:
- subprocess: Run vina and vina_split
- pathlib, shutil, glob: Manage inputs and output files
- json, re: Parse and serialize docking results
- vina, vina_split: AutoDock Vina command-line programs

Can handle:
- Rigid-receptor docking of prepared PDBQT ligands
- Batch docking of prepared PDBQT ligands
- Vina and Vinardo scoring; AD4 scoring when compatible maps are supplied
- Splitting a multi-pose PDBQT file with vina_split

IMPORTANT PATHS:
- /app/inputs: Prepared PDBQT files and optional box configuration or affinity maps, mounted read-only
- /work: Writable working directory and output directory captured by Discovery

When invoking this Python code environment, set outputMounts to ["/work"]. The launcher runs the script in /work and records stdout and stderr in /work/logs.out. Use Path('/work') for all output files and absolute paths for inputs. The runner supplies scriptName. Execute Vina with subprocess.run and check=True; the launcher preserves the Python script's exit status.

Python example:
  import subprocess
  subprocess.run(["vina", "--receptor", "/app/inputs/receptor.pdbqt",
                  "--ligand", "/app/inputs/ligand.pdbqt",
                  "--config", "/app/inputs/box.txt",
                  "--cpu", "1", "--seed", "42",
                  "--out", "/work/docked.pdbqt"], check=True, cwd="/work")

The box configuration must define center_x, center_y, center_z, size_x, size_y, and size_z. Vina prints an affinity table in kcal/mol and writes pose scores as REMARK VINA RESULT lines in the output PDBQT. Scores are predictions, not measured binding affinities. Use --cpu no greater than the allocated CPU count.

This image includes the Vina executables and Python for orchestration. It does not include Vina Python bindings, Meeko, ligand/receptor preparation, AutoGrid, or AmberTools; prepare PDBQT inputs before running.

Commands: vina --help; vina_split --help; python3; sh.
